description:
Forget a saved login by the `id` `list_connections` returned. This deletes Bowmark's own record and cookies for it — it does NOT sign the account out on the site, and it cannot be undone; the user signs in again to get a working connection back.

Only call this when the user asked to remove a saved login. To sign out of a site, use `logout_connection` instead. Never call it to "fix" a connection that is merely stale — `needs_reauth`/`expired` recover with a new sign-in, not a delete.
name: delete_connection
title: Forget one of the user's saved logins
